cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Color Signal
cards.useCase: Adult-led table prompt for choosing one color signal before a short market tale: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print one card for each writer, set crayons nearby, and say the porch-light motif belongs only on the paper card: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick one color for the signal, then use it to decide what changes in the story: ____________________.
cards.signalFrontPrompt: Front: Color the pretend paper porch-light signal with one story color: ____________________.
cards.signalBackPrompt: Back: That color tells the Moon Muffin Market clerk to set out ____________________.
cards.storySignalPrompt: When the signal glows on the paper card, the next customer asks for ____________________.
cards.firstLineSignal: First line: The moon muffins turned ____________________ just before the market bell.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one color clue that changes what a character does: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to your chosen color and write only one word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At another table, ask an adult to name one pretend market color: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Post Office Message Signal
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper prompt for turning a tiny pretend message into a story choice: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold it once, set pencils nearby, and keep every helper made up for the page: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write or draw a tiny pretend message, then decide what the puddle parcel should do next: ____________________.
cards.signalFrontPrompt: Front: Draw a dot, dash, or swirl on the pretend paper porch-light stamp: ____________________.
cards.signalBackPrompt: Back: The Puddle Planet sorter reads it as this message: ____________________.
cards.storySignalPrompt: The paper signal tells the puddle parcel to visit this made-up place: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSignal: First line: The puddle parcel wobbled when it read, ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Add a clearer message clue so the helper knows what to do: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the message mark first, then label it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Share one pretend post-office message starter with an adult: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Sound Signal
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable prompt for using one gentle sound cue to start a library train scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the printed card beside blank paper, invite one soft sound effect, and turn it into a story clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Choose the signal sound and decide what it tells one book, cart, or character to do: ____________________.
cards.signalFrontPrompt: Front: Mark the pretend paper porch-light signal with a sound sign: ____________________.
cards.signalBackPrompt: Back: In Buttonwood Library Train, that sound means the book cart should ____________________.
cards.storySignalPrompt: When the signal sound repeats, one shelf book begins to ____________________.
cards.firstLineSignal: First line: The quiet train car heard ____________________ from the tallest stack.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one sound cue before the surprise so readers can predict it: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Tap the rhythm on the table, then write the sound word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Ask an adult for a gentle library sound to borrow: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Map Mixup Sequence Signal
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper card for ordering three silly bakery clues before drafting: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and provide three small paper arrows or number dots for a fictional table sequence: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Put the clues in first, next, and last order, then write the mixup scene: ____________________.
cards.signalFrontPrompt: Front: Number the pretend paper porch-light crumbs in the order they blink: ____________________.
cards.signalBackPrompt: Back: The Button Bakery mixup begins when crumb number one points to ____________________.
cards.storySignalPrompt: Use the signal order to move from mixup to fix: first ____________________, next ____________________, last ____________________.
cards.firstLineSignal: First line: The button baker followed crumb one and found ____________________ instead of icing.
cards.revisionNudge: Check the order clue; add one missing middle step: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle first, next, or last, then write the chosen step: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Tell an adult the funniest paper mixup: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Weather Mood Signal
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable card for matching a pretend weather mood to a character choice: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and set blue, yellow, gray, and green crayons nearby for fictional table writing: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick one weather mood for the signal, then show how it changes the teacup tale: ____________________.
cards.signalFrontPrompt: Front: Shade the pretend paper porch-light teacup with a weather mood: ____________________.
cards.signalBackPrompt: Back: In Teacup Town, that mood makes the cafe table feel ____________________.
cards.storySignalPrompt: The signal changes how the tiny cup keeper speaks: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSignal: First line: The teacup sky looked ____________________ when the spoon parade paused.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one mood word and one object that matches it: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Pick a color silently and write the mood it makes: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Ask an adult which pretend weather mood fits a teacup tale: ____________________.
